markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: **must / have to** 是「必须」；**mustn't** 是「不许」；**don't have to** 是「不必」；**should** 是「最好、应该」；**had better** 是「最好……不然有麻烦」。

uses.en_zh: 我必须在周五前做完这个。

uses.en: You [[don't have to]] ((come)) to the meeting.

uses.en_zh: 你应该跟你的经理谈谈。

must.title: 必须：must 和 have to
must.text: 意思差不多。**must 是自己心里觉得必须**；**have to 是规定、别人要求的**。拿不准就用 have to，日常说话它更常见。

items.zh: 我今晚一定得给妈妈打个电话。

items.en: We [[have to]] ((wear)) a badge in the office.
items.zh: 在办公室我们必须戴工牌。

items.en: She [[has to]] ((fix)) it before the release.
items.zh: 她必须在发版前修好它。

notes: have to 是普通动词，问句和否定要请 do 帮忙：[[Do]] you [[have to]] ((work)) at the weekend?

mustnt.title: 不许和不必
mustnt.text: 最容易搞反的一对！**mustn't = 不许做**（红灯，做了就错）；**don't have to = 不用做**（绿灯，做不做都行）。

items.zh: 你不许把密码告诉别人。
不许直接推到 main 分支。

items.en: You [[don't have to]] ((wear)) a suit on Fridays.

wrong.bad: You ~~don't have to~~ smoke in here. It's against the rules.
wrong.good: You [[mustn't]] ((smoke)) in here. It's against the rules.

past.title: 过去和将来
past.text: must 没有过去式。说「当时必须」用 **had to**，「当时不必」用 **didn't have to**；说将来用 **will have to**。

examples.en: We [[didn't have to]] ((pay)) for the tickets.
examples.zh: 我们当时不用花钱买票。

examples.en: You[['ll have to]] ((update)) the app <<next week>>.
examples.zh: 下周你得更新这个 App。

should.title: 提建议：should / ought to
should.text: should 是温和地说「我觉得你最好……」，不是命令。**ought to** 意思一样，只是更正式一点。

examples.zh: 我们不应该在周五发版。

better.title: 最好……不然：had better
better.text: had better 比 should **语气重**，意思是「最好赶紧……，不然会有麻烦」。常缩写成 **'d better**，后面跟原形，否定是 **'d better not**。

examples.en: We[['d better]] ((leave)) now, or we'll miss the train.
examples.zh: 我们最好现在就走，不然要赶不上火车了。

examples.en: I[['d better]] ((check)) the logs before I go home.
examples.zh: 我回家前最好看一下日志。

better.tip: had better 虽然有 had，说的是现在和马上，不是过去。

that.meaning: don't have to：不必，做不做都行

that.en: You[['d better]] ((save)) your work — the battery's dying.

commonMistakes.bad: You ~~don't have to~~ park here. It's for staff only.
commonMistakes.good: You [[mustn't]] ((park)) here. It's for staff only.
commonMistakes.why: 「不许」用 mustn't；don't have to 是「不必」。

commonMistakes.bad: He ~~have to~~ work at the weekend.

commonMistakes.why: had better not 后面直接跟原形。
过去的「必须」用 had to。

quiz.prompt: You ___ come tomorrow. It's a holiday.
quiz.explain: 放假了，不用来：[[don't have to]]。

quiz.prompt: She ___ (have to) fix it before the release.
改成一般疑问句：You have to work at the weekend.
quiz.answer: Do you have to work at the weekend?
accept: Do you have to work on the weekend?

traps.input: Have you to work at the weekend?
traps.note: have to 要请 do 帮忙变问句。

quiz.explain: have to 是普通动词：[[Do]] you [[have to]] …？

quiz.prompt: You ___ share your password with anyone.
You ___ wear a suit. Jeans are fine.
quiz.explain: 牛仔裤也行，就是「不必」：[[don't have to]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：You don't have to smoke in here. It's against the rules.
quiz.answer: You mustn't smoke in here. It's against the rules.
accept: You must not smoke in here. It's against the rules.

quiz.prompt: I ___ (have to) work late last night.

traps.note: must 没有过去式，用 had to。

quiz.prompt: 改成过去时：We don't have to pay for the tickets.
quiz.answer: We didn't have to pay for the tickets.
accept: We did not have to pay for the tickets.

quiz.prompt: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.（给个建议）
改错：You should to see a doctor.
翻译：我们不应该在周五发版。
quiz.answer: We shouldn't release on a Friday.
accept: We should not release on a Friday.
We should not release on Friday.

quiz.prompt: We ___ leave now, or we'll miss the train.
改错：You'd better not to be late again.
quiz.answer: You'd better not be late again.
accept: You had better not be late again.
quiz.explain: had better not 后面直接跟原形：[['d better not]] ((be))。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He have to work at the weekend.
quiz.answer: He has to work at the weekend.
accept: He has to work on the weekend.

quiz.prompt: Your battery is at 2%. You ___ save your work now!
quiz.explain: 不保存就有麻烦，用语气重的 [[had better]]。

quiz.answer: You don't have to come to the meeting.
accept: You do not have to come to the meeting.
You needn't come to the meeting.

traps.input: You mustn't come to the meeting.
traps.note: mustn't 是「不许来」，不是「不必来」。

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话介绍你们团队的规矩：一件必须做的事（have to），一件不许做的事（mustn't），一件不必做的事（don't have to）。再给新同事一条建议（should）。
rules: mustn't 表示不许，don't have to 表示不必，不能混用
must / should / had better 后面用原形，不加 to；he / she 用 has to
openTask.note: 规则判 mustn't 和 don't have to 是否用对、情态动词后的原形（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
